name: Playwright Accessibility Testing MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive WCAG 2.0/2.1 accessibility testing of web applications using Playwright and axe-core. Supports natural language element finding, auto-discovery of interactive components, and generates detailed compliance reports with screenshots.
